test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The study of languages
solution: The correct answer is **Philology**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Philology: **the branch of knowledge that deals with the structure, historical development, and relationships of a language or languages. (भाषाशास्त्र) • **Example: **At the start of the novel Julia sees ***philology* **as a lifeless and uncreative pursuit. • Thus, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Anthropology: **the study of human beings, especially of their origin, development, customs and beliefs. (मानव की उत्‍पत्ति, उसके विकास, प्रथाओं और विश्‍वासों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; मानव-विज्ञान) • **Lexicography: **the theory or practice of writing dictionaries. (शब्दकोश लेखन का सिद्धांत या पेशा) • **Philosophy: **the study of ideas and beliefs about the meaning of life. (जीवन के अर्थ एवं मतों से संबंधित विचारों का अध्ययन; दर्शन-शास्‍त्र) 1b7:T88a, The correct answer is **unsatisfactory.**
